narr: Severe thunderstorms moved across Southeastern Arizona causing strong winds, hail ranging from 0.75 to 1.0 inches in diameter, and locally heavy rainfall that led to flash flooding. A swift water rescue occurred near Tombstone involving 5 individuals with no injuries. Additionally, an estimated 8 to 12 inches of water flowed underneath the Bowie underpass roadway shown on webcam.
ev: Swift water rescue for 5 individuals trapped in car on Gleeson Rd. All individuals rescued with no injury.
Online article described a swift water rescue for 5 individuals on Old Spanish Trail Rd. An estimated 12 to 18 inches of running water in wash that went over the roadway. No one was injured.
Arizona Department of Transportation camera showed an estimated foot of water moving across Apache Pass Road in Bowie, AZ. A nearby rain gauge recorded 0.43 inches of rainfall.
